requirement.title: Document language syntax highlighting and split preview with hide-toggle
requirement.story: As a writer editing markup/documentation files (AsciiDoc, reStructuredText, Markdown) I want syntax highlighting in the editor and a rendered preview beside it, with a button that hides either the preview or the editing pane, so I can focus on writing or reviewing the rendered document.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-001: detectDocumentKind recognizes rst for .rst/.rest, asciidoc for .adoc/.asciidoc, markdown for .md/.markdown, and unknown otherwise.
AC-002: The editor maps document kinds to non-plaintext Monaco language ids (markdown/asciidoc/rst) and registers AsciiDoc and reStructuredText token definitions so syntax highlighting is applied.
AC-003: The document preview renders rst content (adornment headings and paragraphs) alongside markdown and asciidoc.
AC-004: For a markup/documentation file the document pane splits the screen: editor on the left, preview on the right.
AC-005: A toolbar button cycles view modes split -> preview-only (hides the editor) -> editor-only (hides the preview) -> split; nextDocumentViewMode is pure and total.
AC-001: detectDocumentKind returns rst for guide.rst and guide.rest, asciidoc for .adoc/.asciidoc, markdown for .md/.markdown, and unknown otherwise.
AC-002: getDocumentEditorLanguage maps markdown/asciidoc/rst to non-plaintext Monaco ids and registerDocumentLanguages registers AsciiDoc and reStructuredText Monarch token providers.
AC-003: DocumentPreviewPanel renders rst content (adornment headings and paragraphs) in addition to markdown and asciidoc.
AC-004: The document pane for a markup/documentation file shows the editor on the left and the preview on the right.
AC-005: nextDocumentViewMode cycles split -> preview-only -> editor-only -> split and is total over DOCUMENT_VIEW_MODES; a toolbar toggle button hides the preview pane or the editing pane.
qualityConstraints: The view-mode state machine and document-kind detection stay pure in @ide/contracts so they are testable without a running UI.
The toggle cycle is deterministic and total: every DocumentViewMode maps to another DocumentViewMode.
AsciiDoc and reStructuredText language registration uses Monarch token providers scoped to the document editor pane.
Existing markdown and asciidoc preview behavior remains unchanged; rst is additive.
exclusions: Full reStructuredText directive/role parsing (only headings and paragraphs are rendered in this slice).
Changing the existing desktop Editor props or diagnostics wiring (the toggle wraps the existing Editor and preview).
Web-app file-opening/preview wiring (the reusable DocumentSplitPane is exported; desktop App is wired in this slice).
Theme/CSS polish beyond the document-split-pane layout.

evidence.status: GREEN for pure-logic spec; desktop wiring verified by code inspection; story is living documentation for the UI behavior.
